newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary sets HUF 8 bln per channel TV concessions.
newsitem.headline: Hungary sets HUF 8 bln per channel TV concessions.

text.p: Hungary set an eight billion forints ($49 million) per channel per year concession fee for two television channels due to be privatised later this year.
Hungarian television said that successful bidders will have to pay three years' fee in advance.

Hungary's media law, passed in December 1995, opened the way for the privatisation of a television market that attracted 16 billion forints ($100.8 million) worth of advertisers' money in the first half of 1996.
Only consortia are expected to bid and no single company is allowed to have more than a 49 percent stake, while Hungarians have to hold a minimum of 26 percent.
